summary_markdown: The discussion focused on a data anomaly concerning campaign 7912. [p1] reported that the unique metrics (юнікі) were only available for the last two days, and attempts to re-aggregate the data failed. Additionally, dwell time data was missing. [me] asked which `ml_2` dataset should be used for 7912, and [p1] specified using the 'prod - 8' dataset.
decisions: Use the 'prod - 8' dataset for campaign 7912 data analysis.
